title: When acceptance slips back into doubt
subtitle: For the heart that keeps cross-examining what it has received
description: These readings catch the slide from Hukam into suspicion and bring the mind back before doubt can reopen every door.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Hukam steadies the heart when acceptance is tempted to become another argument.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When questioning returns, receive the fact before building a case against it.

evidence.coreClaim: This path protects acceptance from collapsing into endless review.
evidence.turn: Doubt loses force when the heart practices receiving before explaining.
evidence.practicalImplication: Say what is true about the situation, then act within it without reopening the whole argument.
